name: Dragon Adventures
notes: Dragon Adventures 0.9.4-r2: a mounted fire burst has a single off-owner that refuses to end the cone or glow while now < fireBurstUntil unless the reason is a *confirmed* dismount, menu, or death (a one-frame riding flicker cannot pass as dismount). Every fx fire-cone/glow off line includes reason= and burstLeft=; a once-per-second fx fire tick logs the remaining ms while fire is active. Pickaxe misses log the nearest rock's distance, angle, and assist decision, assist is range+1 m at dot 0.2, and the toast says which way to walk (Nearest rock: 6 m to your left). B toggles Build (I stays Bag); both hotkeys release pointer lock; the on-screen Build and Bag buttons hit-test even while locked; the Build button shows a B hint. Schema v5, IDB/cacheId/test-* denylist unchanged. Do not mutate after SHA256SUMS.
